limits: Native original EXE is used only by the comparison oracle; no original EXE or interpreter executes in the shipped game.
All ten selectable original story routes use test-only forced KO to exercise progression; native character/action/object/collision tests cover combat separately.
Phone layout/touch is verified in Chromium simulation. Device-specific driver, latency and FPS require phone testing.

All 13 supplied original matches passed full per-frame gameplay state comparison (226898 frames). Rendering/audio are excluded from that oracle, and initial common actor state is supplied from C++; browser visuals/audio and constructors have separate tests. This does not prove every possible route or input is bug-free.
